build_MapData_from_osm: build a MapData object from raw OSMData by parsing nodes, ways, areas, and multipolygon relations
create_MapArea_from_relation: create a MapArea with outer and inner polygon rings from an OSM multipolygon relation
glue_OSM_ways: glue a list of OSM ways into connected paths by joining shared endpoints and detecting cycles
parse_multipolygon_relation: parse an OSM relation into inner and outer way paths for multipolygon area construction
construct_MapLine_from_way: construct a MapLine with stacked node coordinates from an OSM way for line-based map features
